images.screen: A · 가을 밭 — 물·씨앗 예산 안에서 밭 칸에 작물을 심고, 익은 고추를 거두면 그대로 겨울 덱의 '불씨' 카드가 된다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Cozy farming-meets-deckbuilder game in a warm hand-painted gouache storybook style, late autumn afternoon: a golden low sun, ochre hills, orange trees, a red barn with white trim, a stone well and a scarecrow. Three-quarter top-down view of six tilled soil plots in a 3x2 grid at center — young wheat sprouts, a bed of ripe glossy red chili peppers with a small '!' bubble, a bed of round orange pumpkins, one empty plot glowing with a dashed highlight ready for planting, two locked plots drawn as faded dashed outlines. Cream pill-shaped labels under each plot show plot name, fertility percent and growth turns. Left: rounded cream seed pouch panel listing turnip, pumpkin, chili, herb, wheat each with an arrow to the card it becomes. Right: a deep navy 'winter deck' panel stacking mini cards with counts, pending ones dashed in amber — the harvest literally becomes the deck. Top: season pill bar with autumn highlighted. Falling leaves, paper texture. Korean HUD: '가을', '겨울 덱', '씨앗 주머니'.

images.screen: B · 겨울 밤 — 창고 문 앞 눈밭에서 굶주린 이리와 싸운다. 손패의 카드마다 그 작물을 어느 밭에서 거뒀는지 적혀 있다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same painterly storybook world on a winter night: deep indigo sky, a large glowing full moon upper right, dark pine silhouettes, soft falling snow over a blue-white snowfield. Left: a red barn with snow on the roof, its open door spilling warm lantern-orange light across the snow, crates of pumpkins inside. Center right: a lean starving wolf in dark navy silhouette with raised hackles and one glowing amber eye, frosty breath, a health bar and a speech-bubble intent '공격 12' above it. Bottom: a fanned hand of five chunky rounded cream cards, each with a painted crop illustration — wheat sheaf, red chilies, pumpkin, turnip, herb — the card name, effect, and a small provenance line naming the field and season it was harvested from. Three glowing paper lanterns at lower right as energy, player health panel lower left. A soft handwritten line mid-screen about planting this wheat. Cold blue and warm amber contrast. Korean HUD: '겨울 밤', '굶주린 이리', '수확'.
